create_dpt_depth_model: create a DPTDepthModel instance with a specified backbone and feature dimensions for monocular depth estimation
run_dpt_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the DPT model to extract multi-scale feature layers from input images
build_fusion_block: build a FeatureFusionBlock_custom with configurable features, batch norm, and activation for feature refinement
review_dpt_backbone_hooks: review the DPT class hook configurations for BEiT, Swin, LeViT, and ViT backbone transformer architectures
refactor_dpt_depth_head: refactor the DPTDepthModel head sequential layers to adjust output channels or add non-negative depth constraints
